units.source_text: 源氏公子谆谆开导她说：“我离京之后，

en.t: Prince Genji gently reasoned with her and said, "After I leave the capital,

units.source_text: 倘朝廷犹不赦罪，多年流放在外，

en.t: if the court still does not pardon my offense and I remain in exile for many years,

units.source_text: 那时虽居岩穴之中，我亦必迎接你去同居。

en.t: then even if I am living in a cave among the rocks, I will surely bring you to live with me.

units.source_text: 惟现在与你同行，深恐外人指责。

en.t: But if I take you with me now, I greatly fear that others will condemn us.

units.source_text: 身为钦犯之人，日月光明也不得见，

en.t: As one condemned by imperial order, I am not even permitted to see the light of the sun and moon,

units.source_text: 倘任情而动，罪孽更加深重。

en.t: and if I act only on my feelings, my guilt will become still heavier.

units.source_text: 我今生虽未犯过，但前世必有恶业，故而有此报应。

en.t: Although I have committed no offense in this life, I must have done evil in a former life, and this is the retribution.

units.source_text: 何况流放犯携带家眷，古无前例。

en.t: Besides, there has never been any precedent for an exile to take his family with him.

units.source_text: 在这无法无天的世间，可能遭受更大的祸殃呢。”

en.t: In this lawless world, we might suffer an even greater disaster."

units.source_text: 翌晨，到了日上三竿之时，公子方才起身。

en.t: The next morning, when the sun was already high, the prince finally rose.
